name: Kudremukha Trek
shortDescription: A breathtaking trek through lush grasslands, endemic forests, and panoramic viewpoints of the Western Ghats.

name: Netravathi Trek
shortDescription: Explore dense evergreen forests, rivers, and hidden waterfalls in a remote stretch of the Western Ghats.

name: Kurinjal Trek
shortDescription: A route of waterfalls, narrow ridgelines and sweeping views — designed for experienced trekkers who want a true wilderness feel.

name: Bandaje Falls Trek
shortDescription: A hidden valley trek with river crossings, dense forest and spectacular ridgelines — perfect for nature lovers.
